> 第十六章 胖子鲍斯（第1页）
可能是莉娜的身材极为娇小的缘故，她在床底之间的表现，可没有她高级学徒的那般风范。
塞恩的体质也不算差，今年才十六岁的他，未来还起码有好几年的成长空间。
依照塞恩的体质成长速度，等到25岁，也就是他身体素质各方面都处于巅峰之际，他的体质数值很有可能突破12点。
对比那些体质强壮的牛头人，又或者是另有天赋的地底亚人，塞恩的这点体质的确不算什么。
但在黑魔法师这一群体中，他的这份体质却是足够用了。
毕竟不是所有黑魔法师都像疤脸乔克一样专门磨砺自己的体质和力量，连莉娜都有些吃不消塞恩的力量，更何况是其它魔法学徒。
随着年级考核之日到来，素来沉寂的黑魔法学院，渐渐热闹了起来。
许多外出执行任务的学徒纷纷返回，包括那些长时间待在自己宿舍楼或图书馆的学徒们，也三三两两出现在学院的各个角落。
除了同居女友莉娜之外，塞恩这些年其实也是有几个“朋友”的。
没有足够的实力，独行侠在黑魔法学院很难混得下去。
特别是那些刚来黑魔法学院的入门级学徒，深知报团取暖和依附靠山的重要性。
塞恩的普通朋友有不少，但要说真正能够交心，并知根知底的，只有两个。
“嘿，胖子，好久不见。”行走在魔法学院的诸多建筑之间，塞恩冲迎面走来的一名大腹便便魔法学徒打招呼道。
胖子鲍斯，与塞恩十年前一同来到黑魔法学院的那批少年之一。
因为有过并肩作战、共同争抢并守护食物的经历。
因此这么多年下来，他们的关系变得越来越好。
特别是同期来的那批魔法学徒，很多都已经因为各式各样的缘故死亡，鲍斯和塞恩应该算是结识最久的一对朋友了。
已经死掉的低阶学徒伊尔克，他应该还有另一个仇人，就是眼前的鲍斯。

因为严格来算，鲍斯当年也是抢夺他弟弟食物的罪魁祸首
面对塞恩的招呼，鲍斯先是一愣，紧接着面庞的肥肉一颤，笑着张开双手向塞恩走来。
之所以没有第一时间认出塞恩，是因为塞恩此时戴着一副白色的面具。
“哈哈，塞恩，我早就听说了你过去两个月干成的大事！”
“听说你现在还被一位伟大的正式黑魔法师收为弟子了？”
“这幅面具不会就是你从伊尔克手里缴获的苍白面具吧？低级魔法道具，快让我瞅瞅。”
鲍斯也是一名低级学徒，只不过与塞恩不同的是，这家伙对冥想和钻研魔法没什么兴趣，反而更喜欢经商，对黑金更感兴趣。
黑街是黑魔法学院内部的商业街，但其实在魔索布拉城，城区内也有相应的数条商业街，并且那里卖的东西来路更野，也时常需要跟地底亚人或其它一些黑暗生物们打交道。
胖子鲍斯目前主要就是在那里干活，虽然没有被正式黑魔法师收为弟子，但他所经营的那间店铺，背后似乎就有某位黑魔法师的影子。

The latest chapter of Lord of Ashes_Chapter 16 Fatty Bose Page 1_Lord of Ashes I Love Xiaodou_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 16 Fat Boss (Page 1)
Perhaps because of Lina's extremely petite figure, her behavior under the bed was not as graceful as that of her senior apprentice.
Thain's physique is not bad either. He is only sixteen years old and has at least several years of room for growth in the future.
According to Thain's physical growth rate, when he is 25 years old, when his physical fitness is at its peak in all aspects, his physical fitness value is likely to exceed 12 points.
Compared with those tauren with strong physiques, or the underground people with other talents, Thain's physical fitness is really nothing.
But among the group of black magicians, his physique is enough.
After all, not all black magicians specialize in honing their physique and strength like Scarface Jock. Even Lina can't handle Thane's power, let alone other magic apprentices.
With the arrival of the grade assessment day, the usually silent Black Magic Academy gradually became lively.
Many apprentices who went out to perform tasks returned one after another, including those who stayed in their dormitories or libraries for a long time, and appeared in twos and threes in every corner of the college.
In addition to his live-in girlfriend Lina, Thain actually has a few "friends" over the years.
Without enough strength, it would be difficult for a lone ranger to survive in the Black Magic Academy.
Especially those entry-level apprentices who have just come to the Black Magic Academy, they know the importance of joining a group for warmth and relying on a supporter.
Thain has many ordinary friends, but there are only two who can truly be close to each other and understand him.
"Hey, Fatty, long time no see." Walking among the many buildings of the Magic Academy, Thain greeted a potbellied magic apprentice who was coming towards him.
Fatty Boss was one of the teenagers who came to the Black Magic Academy with Thane ten years ago.
Because we have the experience of fighting side by side, fighting for and protecting food together.
So over the years, their relationship has gotten better and better.
Especially among the batch of magic apprentices who came at the same time, many have died due to various reasons. Baos and Thain should be regarded as the pair of friends who have known each other for the longest time.
The low-level apprentice Irk, who is already dead, should have another enemy, and that is Bose in front of him.
Because strictly speaking, Bose was also the culprit who robbed his younger brother of food.
Facing Thain's greeting, Bos was stunned for a moment, then the fat on his face trembled, he smiled and walked towards Thain with open hands.
The reason why Thain was not recognized immediately was because Thain was wearing a white mask at this time.
"Haha, Thain, I have long heard about the great things you have done in the past two months!"
"I heard that you are now accepted as a disciple by a great official black magician?"
"Isn't this mask the pale mask you captured from Irk? It's a low-level magic item. Let me take a look."
Boss is also a low-level apprentice, but unlike Thane, this guy has no interest in meditation or studying magic. Instead, he prefers doing business and is more interested in black gold.
The Black Street is the commercial street within the Black Magic Academy, but in fact, in the city of Mensobra, there are also several corresponding commercial streets in the city, and the goods sold there come from more wild sources, and they often need to deal with the Underdians or other dark creatures.
Fatty Boss is currently working there. Although he has not been officially accepted as a disciple by a black magician, the shop he runs seems to have the shadow of a certain black magician behind it.
